properties.Description:
\## Outcome
Repository-wide mining hardening across iGPU, tensor compute, VQC, manifolds, traversal, SHA-256d, ASIC boundaries, provenance and release gates.

## Implemented
- canonical \`gpu\` package with lazy backend, fleet, tensor, VQC and manifold facades
- deterministic matrix/vector, QFI, Grover/Hendrix and SHA-256d references
- integrated measured tensor/GPU/ASIC runtime from PR #29
- exact-permutation tensor advice; advice cannot mutate certified nonce work
- measured H/s and TFLOPs remain separate
- fixed hybrid accounting so unavailable counters never imply work was executed
- packaged \`hyba\`, \`hyba.hybrid\`, \`hyba.math\_ir\` and \`hyba.operating\_model\`
- implemented OpenCL manifold punch \`0x15\` with CPU parity and explicit backend evidence
- repaired the OpenCL fallback-source initialization bug
- implemented exact mining traversal references for Lucas, Pisot permutation, Cassini affine stepping, Morton ordering and Korobov lattice points
- wired every traversal kernel through the seam instead of returning placeholder data
- reject uint32 nonce windows that wrap and could repeat work
- fail-closed VQC access and canonical Aethel manifold facade
- \`pythia-gpu-readiness\` software/external-evidence gates
- production provenance validation rejecting placeholders
- corrected stale unified-manifold documentation and classification
- expanded regression tests and implementation audit

## Claim boundary
Only protocol-valid SHA-256d hashes actually executed per measured wall time count as H/s. TFLOPs, folds, quantum dimensions, tensor scores, swarm size and genetic policy do not multiply hashrate.

## Remaining mining release blockers
These require infrastructure or physical systems and cannot be fabricated in code:
1. Target iGPU/discrete-GPU OpenCL conformance, including punch \`0x15\` and traversal parity.
2. Physical ASIC protocol test.
3. Real hardware job, host verification, pool submission and pool acknowledgement.
4. Post-human-merge production provenance.
5. Built-image and cache-size measurement.

## Non-blocking follow-up
- PR #30 governance-contract review
- reversible/uncompute and ZK kernels (outside the mining consensus path; fail closed)
- final staged backend source migration
- optional 32-face legacy ordering-device promotion

## Validation
- focused reference, tensor accounting, traversal completeness, nonce-window, CPU manifold-punch parity, readiness and packaging checks passed
- Python compilation and TOML/script registration passed
- changed Python files pass line-length checks
- local credential-pattern scan found no findings
- GitHub Advanced Security secret scanning is unavailable

The software mining path is implemented and fail-closed. PR #32 remains open until CI and the five external evidence gates complete.
